title: Do concept vectors generalize from instruct models to their base counterparts?

original_idea.body: Extract a concept vector on the instruct model, then check whether it is linearly decodable in the base model and whether it transplants for steering, across 3-4 concepts.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: whether safety directions are pretrained vs RLHF-installed informs interventions, but gap to catastrophic-risk reduction.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Extract on instruct, transplant to base; training-free.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open-model interpretability mapping, weak lab incentive.

novelty.reasoning: Base-vs-instruct differences partly studied; transplant framing may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Concept-vector transplant comparison may be open.
